title: A Short Email
text:
Hi Tom, how are you? I am fine, thanks. I write to you from London. It is very cold here.

I want to see you next week. Can you come to my house on Friday? We can eat pizza and watch a film. Write back soon!

questions.text: What can they eat together on Friday?
How does the writer feel about Tom?
options: They are friendly and want to meet him
They want to move to London

questions.text: Why does the writer finish with 'Write back soon!'?
options: They want to end the friendship

vocabulary.definition: a story shown on a screen that you watch at the cinema or at home
in a short time from now
a flat round food with cheese and other toppings

paragraph_translations: Привіт, Томе, як справи? У мене все добре, дякую. Пишу тобі з Лондона. Тут дуже холодно.
Я хочу побачити тебе наступного тижня. Можеш прийти до мене додому в п'ятницю? Ми можемо з'їсти піцу і подивитися фільм. Напиши мені незабаром!
